title: convert.page
description: Recognizes one page image and writes the result as an IR Page JSON file (the `Page` definition of ir.schema.json) to `irPath`. Figure crops are written as PNG files into `cropsDir` and referenced from the IR by absolute path. The engine is stateless between calls: it may keep loaded models, but nothing about earlier pages. Emits convert.progress notifications while it works. Fails with CANCELLED when convert.cancel arrives first; in that case no IR file is written (crops may remain and are cleaned up by Rust).

modelId.description: Manifest model id to use, for example `accurate-paddleocr-vl-1.6`. Recorded in the IR as engine.model.

imagePath.description: A page image written by page.render.

pageIndex.description: Becomes Page.index and the block id prefix (`p{pageIndex}-b{n}`).

irPath.description: Where to write the IR Page JSON. Parent directories are created.

language.description: Fast tier only: recognition language code. Other engines ignore it. Not used by the UI in v0.1.
